description:
## Objective

Measure package, component, and suite line coverage.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U23`
Covers: `R17` through `R19`, `R22`; `KTD10`, `KTD11`, `KTD12`, `KTD16`

The current gate checks only a 90% package total. This task adds component floors, baseline regression checks, and suite contribution evidence.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: `jido-07x.22` for complete component and module ownership.
- Unblocks: `jido-07x.24` for the combined quality report.

## Branch and integration rule

- Base: `main` after the completed U22 ticket.
- Combine: Execute directly on `main` per KTD16. Do not create a branch, worktree, or pull request.

## Source inventory

- One package-wide 90% threshold in `mix.exs` — retain as the minimum.
- 40 component owners from U22 — measure all.
- Required offline suite aliases from the quality contract — export each separately.
- Old core ExCoveralls export and `coveralls.json` at commit `21d0dd4c4da2f9c096fbd1cec9ad1d22dce95e61` — adapt, do not copy package setup.

## API and behavior map

- Old core ExCoveralls export -> consolidated per-suite exports. Evidence: `../refs/jido_v3_split/mix.exs` at the baseline commit.
- Package-only coverage -> package union plus component and suite tables. Evidence: `mix.exs` and U22 ownership.

## Files

- Read: `mix.exs`, `mix.lock`, `.reach.exs`, `test/quality/quality_contract.yml`, `test/quality/component_proof.yml`
- Change: `mix.exs`, `mix.lock`
- Add: `coveralls.json`, `test/quality/coverage_baseline.json`, `test/quality/coverage_test.exs`, `test/quality/support/coverage.exs`
- Do not change: `lib/**`, `../refs/**`, generated files outside ignored `tmp/quality/coverage/`
- Expected shared changes: `mix.lock` for ExCoveralls

## Instructions

1. Add ExCoveralls as a development and test dependency.
2. Export line coverage separately for every required offline suite.
3. Union suite exports and map production modules to Covenant components.
4. Calculate package, component, total suite, and unique suite coverage.
5. Compare the result with the fixed floors and committed baseline.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Package coverage below 90 fails.
- [ ] A component below 80, below its floor, or more than 0.5 points below baseline fails.
- [ ] An unmapped production module fails.
- [ ] Shared lines count once in the package union.
- [ ] Each suite has total and unique line contribution.
- [ ] No file under `lib/**` or `../refs/**` changes.

## Verification

- `mix test test/quality/coverage_test.exs --seed 0` — exits with status `0`.
- `mix quality.coverage` — writes complete artifacts under `tmp/quality/coverage/` and exits with the recorded outcome.
- `mix format --check-formatted` — exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, baseline values, suite exports, verification results, threshold failures, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
title: Measure package component and suite coverage
